response.rationale: Seventeen of the 18 items, including many T3 and T4 sources (Laufer, Hu and Nation, Schmitt, Nation), show comprehension rising with known-word coverage, with thresholds of about 95% for adequate and 98% for optimal comprehension; the one dissenting item (talk:3, T6, "half is understood") is a low-tier claim that its own text contradicts by citing those same studies, and listening may need somewhat lower coverage (van Zeeland 2013 found 90–95% sufficient), which only adjusts the threshold, not the predictive relationship.
